versions.changelog:
Initial release of postcat-hot-trend skill.

- Provides extraction and summarization for public product and documentation pages of Postcat.
- Supports summarizing features, version info, documentation links, and open-source repository entries.
- Does not support account actions, writing to projects, or reverse engineering APIs.
- Works only with publicly accessible, lightweight content.
- Ensures dynamic page loading and compliance with platform/open-source policies.
